author: K. D. Hardy
title: LeRoy Elementary third-graders lead 2024-25 math MCA participation
text:
According to the Minnesota Department of Education , third-graders at LeRoy Elementary School led all grades in participation for the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Of the 54 students who completed the mathematics assessment at LeRoy Elementary School, 21 were from the third grade.
Based on test standards, 29% of third-grade students were classified as proficient in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state evaluations designed to gauge student achievement toward Minnesota’s academic standards and satisfy both federal and state legislative requirements. These assessments include math, reading, and science, depending on a student’s grade. The majority of students take the MCA, while some who receive special education services and meet certain criteria may participate in the Alt MCA.
Statewide proficiency rates on Minnesota’s MCA assessments have decreased from pre-pandemic figures , according to Minnesota’s Report Card. Math proficiency dropped over 7% from 2019, with reading proficiency declining by nearly 5%.
